name: email-triage
description: Sort inbound email by who wants what: a paid deal, a sales pitch aimed at you, a peer collab, or noise.

kind.instructions: Read `from`, `subject` and `body`. What is the sender trying to get from the recipient? Judge by the direction money would flow.

criteria.paid_deal: The sender, or the brand they represent, wants to PAY the recipient: sponsorship, paid placement, paid content, paid UGC, or a flat fee. Includes offers that are affiliate-only or free-product-only, because those still come from a brand seeking promotion.
criteria.vendor_pitch: The sender wants the recipient to buy or pay for a service or tool, or to give up time for a sales call: agencies, editors, designers, lead-gen, software, audits. Money would flow OUT of the recipient.
criteria.peer_collab: Another creator or operator proposing a non-paid collaboration: guest spot, cross-promo, podcast, joint content.
criteria.non_pitch: Newsletter, product update, automated notification, calendar invite, receipt, event invite, or mail not written to this recipient.

money.instructions: If this is a paid_deal, what has the sender said about money so far? Otherwise not_applicable.

criteria.asks_rates: Asks for rates, pricing, a media kit, or availability, and states no budget.
criteria.states_budget: States a budget, a dollar figure, or a concrete offer amount.
criteria.affiliate_only: Offers commission, revenue share, referral payout, or free product only, with no flat fee.
criteria.not_applicable: Not a paid deal, or none of the above is said.

pays.instructions: Does the sender intend to pay the recipient money, as opposed to selling to them or offering nothing?
